discovery.ja: 矢印をタップして道を準備。出発すると走り出す。
discovery.en: Tap arrows to prepare a route, then press Go.

discovery.ja: 曲がり角をつないで、荷物を受取口へ届けよう。
discovery.en: Connect the turns to bring the parcel to its matching depot.

discovery.ja: 全員を届けよう。時計の場所で少し待つと、交差点を譲れる。
discovery.en: Deliver every parcel. A short wait at the clock can clear the crossing.

discovery.ja: 待ちすぎても、次の交差点でぶつかる。1コマずつ見てみよう。
discovery.en: Waiting too long can block the next crossing. Watch one tick at a time.

discovery.ja: 曲がる場所と待つ場所。ふたりとも届ける計画を作ろう。
discovery.en: Plan the turns and the wait to deliver both parcels.

discovery.ja: 道を整え、交差点が空いてから進もう。
discovery.en: Set the turns and enter after the crossing clears.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 近道がふさがるなら、外側の道を使おう。
discovery.en: When the shortcut is busy, try the outer road.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

counterexamples.label: Direct road meets B; manual cell/beat expectation

discovery.ja: 共有するマスへ入る順番を決めよう。
discovery.en: Choose who enters the shared cell first.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 同じ長さの待機でも、置く側で順番が変わる。
discovery.en: The same wait changes the order when assigned to the other robot.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 相手が出るマスには、同じ拍で入れる。
discovery.en: You may enter a cell on the beat its occupant leaves.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 正面から入れ替わる道を避けよう。

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 経路を整えたら、二台の交差を調整しよう。
discovery.en: After setting the route, tune the crossing.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 最初の交差だけで安心せず、次も確かめよう。
discovery.en: Check the second crossing after clearing the first.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 最初と次の交差で、先を譲る側が変わる。
discovery.en: The robot that goes first changes at the next crossing.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 待機を増やしたとき、二度目の交差も見よう。
discovery.en: When adding a wait, check the second crossing too.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

counterexamples.label: Two beats for B is too late at the second crossing

discovery.ja: 遠回りと待機を組み合わせて通そう。
discovery.en: Combine a detour and a wait to clear the crossing.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 二つの交差と、待つ位置をまとめて考えよう。
discovery.en: Plan both crossings and the location of the wait.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

discovery.ja: 最初はA、次はB。道の長さと待つ場所を使い分けよう。
discovery.en: A first, then B. Use the route length and the right waiting place.

oracle: Independent authored path coordinates plus arithmetic wait expansion

counterexamples.label: Short route with a two-beat B wait meets at second crossing
Waiting after the first crossing cannot repair it
